Before reading code, name the smallest piece of information that must survive from one step to the next. An advanced structure or offline query order packages an invariant across operations. The core mechanism is this: Compress find paths and attach smaller trees beneath larger roots. Treat it as a claim to test after every operation. Write down the state before the first operation, update it once, and ask which part of the claim is still true. If an item is skipped, inserted, or removed, explain why that action cannot destroy an answer that should be retained.
